root.title: Skills directory
root.description: Directory on the Agent Host containing the selected skill folders. Supports ~ and ~/ paths.

skills.title: Selected skills
skills.description: Skill folder names, loaded in this order. Each must contain SKILL.md inside the skills directory. Select between 1 and 64 skills.

id_prefix.title: Skill ID prefix
id_prefix.description: Prefix for published skill IDs: prefix/folder-name. Do not end it with a slash.

max_file_bytes.title: Per-file size limit (bytes)
max_file_bytes.description: Maximum size of each SKILL.md, from 1 to 65,536 bytes (64 KiB). Must not exceed the total size limit.

max_total_bytes.title: Total size limit (bytes)
max_total_bytes.description: Maximum combined content size, from 1 to 262,144 bytes (256 KiB).
